topology_contract.room_graph: accepted rooms are vertices in placement order and consecutive vertices are connected
topology_contract.corridor_bend: one per-call PCG32 bounded(2) draw selects horizontal-first or vertical-first L routing
topology_contract.corridor_raster: radius 0, one-cell-wide orthogonal centerline from room center through each room boundary
topology_contract.fill: a depth-first tree rooted at local (1,1) visits and opens every odd logical cell
topology_contract.connectivity: rooms and corridors contain odd logical cells, so the DFS tree connects every open raster cell into one orthogonal component
topology_contract.cycles: room_attempts 0 produces a perfect-maze raster; every accepted room of minimum size 3x3 permits cycles
topology_contract.border: the full outer raster boundary remains blocked

oracle.method: query every raster cell, count orthogonal open edges, and BFS every open component
oracle.connected_condition: open_cells is nonzero and component_count equals 1
oracle.cycle_condition: open_edges plus component_count is greater than open_cells
